entry.summary:
A childhood interest became a career Connor loves.
After having his interest in agriculture sparked early on at his uncle’s sheep, beef and cropping farm, Connor enjoyed both agriculture and economics at school. He decided to combine these interests at Lincoln University and enrolled in the Bachelor of Commerce in Agriculture. Now, he works as an Agribusiness Analyst with Rabobank. 

Learn more about Connor's journey: https://www.lincoln.ac.nz/degrees-that-work/connor-otoole/
